What Makes It Special: Historic coastal fortification overlooking the Rushikulya estuary area.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Represents Odisha's maritime and colonial-era coastal history.
Suggested Dharohar Feature: 3D fort reconstruction + timeline + old trade-route map
Source Note: Listed in Odisha Tourism's heritage-sites material.
Dharohar_Priority_Reason: Adds maritime/colonial history to the heritage map.

What Makes It Special: Quiet coastal mangrove landscape near the Bay of Bengal.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Shows the relationship between coastal ecology, fishing communities and local livelihoods.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism identifies Bichitrapur for its mangrove forest.

What Makes It Special: A lesser-visited forest landscape with wildlife and scenic routes.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Connects northern coastal Odisha with forest and wildlife heritage.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism lists Rissia/Kuldiha among nature destinations.

What Makes It Special: Historic royal architecture in a quieter part of coastal Odisha.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Adds royal and architectural heritage beyond the major temple circuit.
Suggested Dharohar Feature: Palace story + dynasty timeline + archival-photo gallery
Source Note: Included in Odisha Tourism's heritage-sites material.

What Makes It Special: A forested destination close to Bhubaneswar, associated with Chandaka landscape.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Demonstrates that the capital region has significant natural heritage beyond temples.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism lists Deras among forest/nature destinations.

What Makes It Special: Horseshoe-shaped freshwater lake at the foothills of an ancient fort landscape.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Combines water, landscape and historical geography.
Suggested Dharohar Feature: Lake story + satellite-style map + seasonal bird layer
Source Note: Odisha Tourism calls Ansupa an unexplored/untouched lake destination.
Dharohar_Priority_Reason: Easy-to-connect destination near the central heritage circuit.
Dharohar_Priority_Suggested_Content: Lake map + birdwatching + nearby fort story

What Makes It Special: Riverine landscape around the Mahanadi system and Naraj.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Useful for explaining Odisha's river geography and settlement history.
Suggested Dharohar Feature: Animated river-flow map + historical Cuttack waterway story
Source Note: Odisha Tourism's Bhubaneswar & Cuttack brochure lists Naraj Dam Picnic Point.

What Makes It Special: Historic palace heritage away from Odisha's most-visited temple monuments.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Represents the princely-state and architectural history of the interior belt.
Source Note: Listed in Odisha Tourism's heritage-sites material.

What Makes It Special: Forest and wildlife landscape beside Hirakud Reservoir.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Connects western Odisha's forest ecology with the Mahanadi-Hirakud landscape.
Suggested Dharohar Feature: Wildlife sightings map + reservoir landscape model
Source Note: Odisha Tourism identifies Debrigarh as a nature/wildlife destination.

What Makes It Special: Temple landscape on the Mahanadi with the famous leaning Shiva temple tradition.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Strong local religious identity and distinctive architectural phenomenon.
Source Note: A recognized Sambalpur heritage destination; local traditions should be presented as traditions.

What Makes It Special: Sacred site set amid hills, streams and forested scenery.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Combines religious heritage with the natural landscape of western Odisha.
Source Note: Government tourism sources identify Nrusimhanath as a major attraction.

What Makes It Special: Temple and scenic hill landscape with streams and waterfalls.
Heritage / Cultural Value: A strong example of the overlap between sacred geography and nature.
Source Note: Official tourism material identifies Harishankar among western Odisha attractions.

What Makes It Special: Associated with the origin of the Baitarani and a sacred Brahmeswar Mahadev temple.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Combines river mythology, pilgrimage and dramatic hill scenery.
Suggested Dharohar Feature: Animated Baitarani origin story + terrain map
Source Note: Odisha Tourism describes Gonasika and the river's unusual underground/visible course.
Dharohar_Priority_Reason: River-origin geography plus sacred landscape makes a strong map story.

What Makes It Special: A scenic waterfall close to Keonjhar, less prominent than Odisha's major tourist icons.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Represents Keonjhar's extensive waterfall and forest landscape.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism identifies Sanghagra as a small scenic waterfall near Keonjhar.

What Makes It Special: A larger waterfall near Keonjhar set in a forested landscape.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Useful for showcasing Keonjhar's lesser-known natural heritage.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism identifies Badaghagra among Keonjhar's scenic waterfalls.

What Makes It Special: Mountainous, forested landscape associated with tribal communities and valleys.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Important for linking ecology, indigenous culture and rural landscapes.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism lists Daringbadi-Belghar as a mountain, tribal and valley destination.

What Makes It Special: Historic royal residence in Baripada/Mayurbhanj heritage landscape.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Represents Mayurbhanj's royal and architectural history.
Source Note: Included in Odisha Tourism's heritage-sites material.

What Makes It Special: Odisha's highest peak, with trekking routes and views across the Eastern Ghats.
Heritage / Cultural Value: The surrounding landscape is inhabited by indigenous communities including Paraja, Kondh and Bonda communities.
Suggested Dharohar Feature: 3D terrain map + community stories + trekking route
Source Note: Odisha Tourism describes Deomali as a hidden gem and notes nearby indigenous communities.
Dharohar_Priority_Reason: Strong combination of 3D terrain, tribal culture and nature.
Dharohar_Priority_Suggested_Content: 3D mountain map + oral stories + community culture

What Makes It Special: Scenic confluence of three rivers—Vamsadhara, Chauladhua and Phalaphalia—with a Shiva temple.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Combines sacred geography, river ecology and Eastern Ghats landscapes.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism describes Minajhola as a hidden gem in Rayagada.
Dharohar_Priority_Reason: Rare combination of three rivers, forest and sacred site.

What Makes It Special: Pristine, quiet forested landscape known for biodiversity and remote scenery.
Heritage / Cultural Value: An example of Odisha's lesser-known ecological heritage.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism calls Mandasaru/Silent Valley one of Odisha's lesser-known hidden gems.

What Makes It Special: Tibetan settlement and monastery surrounded by forested hills.
Heritage / Cultural Value: A distinctive cultural landscape created by Tibetan refugee communities in Odisha.
Suggested Dharohar Feature: Interactive cultural map + Tibetan-Odisha heritage story
Source Note: Odisha Tourism highlights the monastery, Tibetan refugee culture and surrounding landscape.
Dharohar_Priority_Reason: Distinctive Tibetan-Odisha cultural story that many visitors miss.

What Makes It Special: Duduma is a major plunge waterfall and Rani Duduma is a nearby cascade-style waterfall.
Heritage / Cultural Value: Connects Machkund river geography with the hill landscapes of southern Odisha.
Source Note: Odisha Tourism's South Odisha brochure describes both waterfalls.
